title: [target] aihub-apk: full-reverse (APK cross-validation for aihub)
body:
### Target ID

aihub-apk

### Target URL or domain

https://github.com/SilentCoderHere/aihub

### Purpose

full-reverse

### Authorization basis

Public open-source repository - source-available reverse engineering for interoperability research in the operator's own fleet RE program. No accounts, no sessions, no third-party systems touched by this brief. The paired .APK cross-validation request is filed separately.

### Scope domains

github.com

### Side effect

read

### State-changing authorization

no

### Probe budget

24

### Execution venue

remote-service

### Surfaces requested

github-issue, cli, jsonl, chat, http-facade

### Evidence expectation

reproduced

### Submitter Role{Moniker}

_No response_

### Notes for the dispatcher

APK REVERSE ENGINEERING for aihub (https://github.com/SilentCoderHere/aihub). Obtain the published release artifact (GitHub/Gitea Releases or F-Droid where listed); extract manifest, permissions, endpoints actually called, embedded providers/routes, trackers; then CROSS-VALIDATE against the source tree both directions (repo <-> APK): claims in source not present in the artifact, and behavior in the artifact not present in source, are the findings. If no APK artifact is published for this target, close the probes as no-artifact-found WITH evidence rather than substituting another build. Extraction axes (owner, 2026-10-28): (1) providers + programmatic integrations (extracted set goes to the Providers lanes), (2) feature matrix + 'routes' used, (3) design cues, (4) interaction methods, (5) wrappers, (6) sign-up/sign-in + provider registration methods, (7) workflows, (8) tools. Self-discovery: classification + tagging are part of the recon output, not assumed going in. Standing owner requirements (2026-10-27): immediate telemetry (streaming/evented, NOT delayed batch exports) and full controls of the surface minus dangerous ops, wherever the target exposes a controllable surface.
